//: The shipped build. tsconfig.json covers src and test so a typecheck sees both, which makes the package root their common ancestor and emits dist/src/... - and every runtime asset path is relative to the compiled file, so openapi/, ui/ and db/ then resolve one directory too deep. Building from src alone keeps the compiled layout identical to the source layout, which is what lets the bundle ship those directories beside dist/ with no code changes.

compilerOptions.//removeComments: The comments in this source are the design record - the measurements, the failures, the reasoning that took a year to acquire. They belong in the repository and not in a package handed to somebody else, where they are worth more than the code they explain. Development runs from source through tsx and is unaffected.
